# Installation configuration parameters for IBM PowerVC {#installation-config-parameters-ibm-powervc}

Before you deploy an OpenShift Container Platform cluster on {{ ibm_power_vc_title }}, you provide parameters to customize your cluster and the platform that hosts it. When you create the `install-config.yaml` file, you provide values for the required parameters through the command line. You can then modify the `install-config.yaml` file to customize your cluster further.
